breakdown.description: Compression process is labeled isothermal but isentropic temperature relation is used (process-model inconsistency).
breakdown.reason: The generated specification repeats the original error exactly: it labels compression as 'isothermal' while using the isentropic relation T2/T1 = (p2/p1)^((gamma-1)/gamma). The ground truth resolves this by clarifying the formula is for isentropic compression, and that isothermal compression would mean T2=T1. The generated text makes no such correction or clarification.
